concerns.text: Task T011 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and is the sole task covering SC-001 (Dataset completeness ≥95%). Without T011, the success criterion for data quality has no implementation path. Additionally, T009 and T012 are also [ ], leaving FR-001 (fallback logic) and FR-003 (logging excluded issues) unimplemented.

Task T017 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is the only task addressing the outlier detection requirement in US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 (IQR method, reporting count/percentage). Its absence means the distribution analysis cannot satisfy the spec's acceptance criteria.

Task T025 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is the sole task implementing FR-007 (Sensitivity Analysis with Parametric Bootstrap and stability proportion). Without this, the hypothesis testing phase cannot meet the functional requirement for sensitivity analysis.

Task T009 description includes 'FAIL LOUDLY' logic that contradicts the Plan's approved fallback strategy (Plan Phase 0.5) which mandates triggering the API fallback, not exiting. While the task exists, the description contains a stale/contradictory instruction that needs editing to align with the plan's 'trigger fallback' logic.
